name: The Last Page
caption_intro: NARRATOR: The final page! Panel 1 is glued shut! Gutters bend light, and the hero awaits your beam!
caption_twist: NARRATOR: ONE FINAL TWIST! The hero vanishes into ink! Light the red mark to close the book forever!
caption_solved: NARRATOR: THE END! You mastered the panels and rewrote reality itself! Thank you for reading!
